summary: Two independent Luna reviews rejected exact head 45335a10. The GitHub producer does not yet prove immutable organization/repository/run identity and accepts redirects; evidence time validation is incomplete. The installer retains caller-selected identity and non-atomic multi-file publication, the verifier post-read metadata check is incomplete, and protected CI omits root lifecycle/generated-root gates.
validation: Reviewed complete e3ff9662..45335a10 diff against REQ-001..REQ-012 and prior REV2 findings.
Reproduced the GitHub API-base regex rejecting the real https://api.github.com endpoint.
Reproduced acceptance of evidence timestamped one year in the future.
GitHub evidence/authority unit suite passed existing tests, demonstrating missing negative coverage.
Inspected installer identity inputs, publication sequence, verifier fstat checks, and protected workflow gates.
No code, host installation, workflow dispatch, external API call, merge, or live mutation occurred.
blockers: Nine review findings must be remediated and independently re-reviewed before test stage.
next_action: Route to Luna code remediation in disjoint GitHub-evidence and installer/filesystem lanes, then commit and re-review the exact clean head.

issues.title: Pinned GitHub API base regex rejects the real endpoint
issues.details: produce-github-authority-evidence.py over-escapes api.github.com and fails before a real REST request; add exact-base positive and near-match negative tests.

issues.title: Organization and repository numeric IDs are not proven by REST responses
issues.details: The producer copies immutable IDs from the contract while querying mutable names. Fetch and validate numeric organization and repository resources before emitting evidence.

issues.title: GitHub REST redirects are accepted
issues.details: urllib follows redirects automatically. Disable redirects or reject any final response not exactly https://api.github.com and add redirect coverage.

issues.title: Supplied run ID is not bound to the protected workflow run
issues.details: Bind the run to exact repository, workflow/path, workflow_dispatch, protected main ref, first attempt, expected job, runner, and terminal status.

issues.title: Future-dated GitHub authority evidence is accepted
issues.details: Reject observedAt timestamps after current time or beyond a tightly bounded documented clock skew and add boundary tests.

issues.title: Installer and helper retain caller-selected runner identity
issues.details: Remove arbitrary --runner-user and --runner-uid authority paths; derive and validate the fixed immutable identity only from trusted install/contract metadata.

issues.title: Eight-file package publication is not atomic or rollback-safe
issues.details: After deauthorization, publish a complete generation atomically or restore the prior generation, and fsync descriptor-relative parent directories.

issues.title: Verifier post-read race check omits security metadata
issues.details: Compare ctime, mode, UID, GID, link count, device, inode, size, and mtime before and after bounded reads.

issues.title: Protected workflow omits root lifecycle and generated-root adversarial gates
issues.details: Run the real package install/reinstall/uninstall test and root-capable generated installed-root verifier in the protected validation job.
